Deploybot: Release paused by deploybot: env-profile mismatch detected for service `inference-api`. staging.profile=runner-lite vs prod.profile=inference-exec. IAM bindings on service accounts differ (preflight rule: env-profile-check).
Alex P: On it — which service account is flagged?
Deploybot: staging SA: `staging-infer-sa@project-id`; prod expected `prod-infer-sa@project-id`. staging lacks `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` and `roles/storage.objectViewer` which prod requires.
Maria L: We pushed a default-SA change to staging last week for cost isolation, so that explains the missing tokenCreator. Not intentional for parity. :thinking_face:
Samir K: We can add the bindings to staging temporarily to unblock, but that increases blast radius. Other option: pin the release to a runtime that avoids cross-project writes. Any one have the exact policy list?
Jen W: Release owner here — demo with customer at 16:00 PT today. Short-lived policy grant + audit trail OK with security? :clock3:
OpsBot: Created runbook task #4589 to add the bindings with TTL 4h and annotate the SA. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/4589 :white_check_mark:
Alex P: I'll do the temporary grant. Command I plan to run:

``
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding staging-infer-sa@project-id \
  --member='serviceAccount:deploy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator'\n
# then:
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding project-id \
  --member='serviceAccount:staging-infer-sa@project-id' \
  --role='roles/storage.objectViewer'\n``

I'll annotate with `release-temp-2743219876`.
Maria L: After grant, run the smoke: `/deploy/test-running --env=staging --service=inference-api --smoke=true` — that replicates the customer flow. :memo:
Alex P: Done — added both roles and annotated SA. Smoke started, logs show successful token mint + cache write.
Samir K: Ran a quick canary load, no auth errors. ✅ Follow-ups: (1) revert the bindings after the window, (2) update infra pipeline to detect SA policy drift, or (3) make runtime fall back to a prod-sa only in prod.
Jen W: Ok to proceed. We'll pin runtime to `v2.4.1` for this rollout (validated in canary). Proceeding with release window.
Alex P: Lifting hold now. Deploybot, please resume release and enforce runtime pin `v2.4.1`. :rocket:
Deploybot: Hold removed per request by Alex P. Release resumed; runtime pinned to v2.4.1. Temporary IAM bindings applied with TTL 4h. Ops task #4589 will track revert.
Maria L: Filing infra follow-up: add env-profile parity checklist to release gating and an automated SA-policy diff alert (PR incoming).
Jen W: Thanks all — I'll add to release notes: "Env-profile parity incident mitigated; runtime v2.4.1 deployed; temporary SA bindings applied and scheduled for revoke."
